description:
Cut the executor-level label and strategic query tests to wiring cases, with label semantics owned by the domain.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/label_query_tests.rs` has 12 tests. Nine re-prove `query_by_label` (`crates/jit/src/domain/queries.rs:278`) through the executor, and three own the composition of `search_issues_with_filters`. `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/label_strategic_tests.rs` has 7 tests that re-prove `query_strategic` (`:336`) through the executor.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each file holds one executor case per query entry point, asserting that the executor reaches the domain query, and the `search_issues_with_filters` composition cases remain.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each removed case's property has an owning test in `crates/jit/src/domain/queries.rs` before the case is removed, so no semantic case remains here; the domain owners are added ahead of this change, which adds none itself.
title: Label and strategic executor tests keep one wiring case each
